_comment: Copy to config.json (gitignored) and fill in real values for a specific bench. This example now reflects the REAL ury_pos flow, reverse-engineered against a live bench in Phase 6 round 2 (see EXECUTION_LOG.md) -- there is no generic create/add_item/submit/pay/close split in this app; see 'flow'/'endpoints' below.
host_header: REPLACE_ME (e.g. sa-testcov-verify.local) -- required when bench_url is a raw dev-server port rather than a proper vhost-routed hostname; Frappe resolves the site purely off the Host header.

endpoints._comment: Real, whitelisted dotted paths in ury/ury/doctype/ury_order/ury_order.py. sync_order handles BOTH create (invoice=None) and add-item/re-sync (invoice=<name>) -- there is no separate add_item endpoint. make_invoice applies payment AND submits the POS Invoice in one call -- there is no separate submit endpoint, and no per-order close endpoint (closing is a separate batch-level POS Closing Entry, out of scope for this harness).

pos_profile: REPLACE_ME -- an existing POS Profile name
waiter: REPLACE_ME -- a user with URY Cashier/Captain role and, ideally, System Manager (to bypass the branch/room assignment checks in sync_order for a scripted actor)
cashier: REPLACE_ME -- same user as waiter is fine for this harness
owner: REPLACE_ME -- same user as waiter is fine for this harness
tables: REPLACE_ME with real URY Table names, e.g. T1, T2, T3 -- picked randomly per actor run so concurrent actors can collide on the same table by design

item_pool.item: REPLACE_ME with a real Item Code that has an Item Price under the POS Profile's selling_price_list

db.user: REPLACE_ME (site DB user from site_config.json, or root -- see PROCESS-privilege caveat below for db_sampler.py)

no_oversell._comment: Confirmed NOT APPLICABLE to this app's POS menu items in Phase 6 round 2: URY menu items are is_stock_item=0 (never touch tabBin at all). Real sell-through-capacity risk in this app lives in URY Stock Reservation vs URY Sales Plan (production-capacity enforcement), which this generic no_oversell/tabBin check cannot see. Left here only for an app that DOES sell stock-tracked items directly.

reservation_atomicity._comment: Real doctype for this app is URY Stock Reservation, not ERPNext's Stock Reservation Entry. Its active/holding-stock status is 'Reserved' (see ury/ury/api/ury_reservation_service.py), not an exclusion of terminal states -- pass active_statuses explicitly or the check silently misclassifies Fulfilled/Released rows too (see invariant_checker.py).
